entities.name: Extended DRX parameters
entities.description: Information element containing extended DRX configuration parameters for power saving in connected mode.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to update its tracking area registration with the network.

entities.name: UE included Extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Condition where the UE has included the Extended DRX parameters IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Network supports eDRX and accepts use
entities.description: Condition where the network supports extended DRX functionality and accepts the UE's request to use eDRX.

entities.name: Network includes Extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Network behavior where the Extended DRX parameters IE is included in the response message when conditions are met.

relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message can contain the Extended DRX parameters IE.
Network inclusion of Extended DRX parameters IE is guarded by the condition that UE included it in request.
Network inclusion of Extended DRX parameters IE is guarded by the condition that network supports and accepts eDRX.
UE including Extended DRX parameters IE in request establishes network behavior to include it in response.
Network supporting and accepting eDRX establishes network behavior to include Extended DRX parameters IE.
